method: Offline 1 mm base-frame XY sweep with 0.5 mm waypoint-Z feasibility intervals. Every point from grasp through max(approach_height, lift_height) is constrained by workspace, camera depth, reachability and configured joint limits.
important_note: These min/max values are axis projections of a coupled 3D feasible volume, not a rectangular box. An arbitrary XYZ combination inside the projections may still be infeasible; validate the exact point with --fake-target dry-run.
excluded_constraints: The JSON has no RGB image-FOV, self-collision, environment-collision, payload/torque, live start-pose or tracking-performance model; those are not represented in this geometric range.
